mapper.sql: id, register_id AS registration_id, chief_complaint, present_illness, present_treatment, past_history, allergy_history, physical_examination, examination_proposal, precaution, diagnosis, treatment_plan, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE medical_record SET chief_complaint = #{chiefComplaint}, present_illness = #{presentIllness}, present_treatment = #{presentTreatment}, past_history = #{pastHistory}, allergy_history = #{allergyHistory}, physical_examination = #{physicalExamination}, examination_proposal = #{examinationProposal}, precaution = #{precaution}, diagnosis = #{diagnosis}, treatment_plan = #{treatmentPlan} WHERE register_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.disease_code AS code, d.disease_name AS name, d.disease_icd AS icd FROM medical_record_disease mrd JOIN disease d ON d.id = mrd.disease_id WHERE mrd.medical_record_id = #{medicalRecordId} AND mrd.diagnosis_type = 'FINAL' ORDER BY d.disease_code, d.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disease WHERE active = TRUE AND id IN #{id}
